description: Use this when the person asks how long the wait or the line is at a crossing or an airport now. Not for another hour or day: use get_usual_wait. Answers one crossing or airport now: each direction, and in it every lane (cars, trucks, coaches, walking, NEXUS, SENTRI, Ready Lane, FAST, or the airport's passport control) with its wait, where the number comes from, when it was read and whether it is older than its source usually is; the usual for this hour beside it.

crossing.description: a crossing's or airport's id as search_border_crossings shows it, or its name (Medyka, San Ysidro, Peace Bridge)

name: get_border_wait
title: Get a border wait
